def _fix_greedy_pairwise_swap(source):
    """Replace the pairwise-swap greedy heuristic (for j.../while i<j...) that
    tries to balance participants among food types, with a monotone search
    over the number of days, reusing the already-computed list of per-type
    counts and the participants count found in the source."""
    try:
        tree = ast.parse(source)
    except SyntaxError:
        return []
    body = tree.body

    n_name = None
    for stmt in body:
        if (isinstance(stmt, ast.Assign) and len(stmt.targets) == 1
                and isinstance(stmt.targets[0], ast.Tuple)):
            elts = stmt.targets[0].elts
            if elts and isinstance(elts[0], ast.Name):
                val = stmt.value
                if (isinstance(val, ast.Call) and isinstance(val.func, ast.Name)
                        and val.func.id == 'map'):
                    n_name = elts[0].id
                    break

    if n_name is None:
        for node in ast.walk(tree):
            if (isinstance(node, ast.Assign) and len(node.targets) == 1
                    and isinstance(node.targets[0], ast.Subscript)):
                sub = node.targets[0]
                sl = sub.slice
                if isinstance(sl, ast.Constant) and sl.value == 0:
                    if isinstance(node.value, ast.Name):
                        n_name = node.value.id
                        break

    if n_name is None:
        return []

    target_idx = None
    counts_var = None
    for idx, stmt in enumerate(body):
        if not isinstance(stmt, ast.For):
            continue
        it = stmt.iter
        if not (isinstance(it, ast.Call) and isinstance(it.func, ast.Name)
                and it.func.id == 'range'):
            continue
        if len(it.args) < 2:
            continue

        if not (isinstance(lo, ast.Constant) and lo.value == 1):
            continue
        if not (isinstance(hi, ast.Call) and isinstance(hi.func, ast.Name)
                and hi.func.id == 'len' and len(hi.args) == 1
                and isinstance(hi.args[0], ast.Name)):

        if not has_while:

        counts_var = hi.args[0].id
        break

        return []

    if target_idx == 0:

def _half_foot_threshold_removal(source):
    """Detects `if remainder % 36 >= ~18: <round whole foot>` guarding a
    correct else-branch; the threshold-based whole-foot rounding is wrong,
    only the else branch's per-inch logic is right."""
    try:
        tree = ast.parse(source)
    except SyntaxError:
        return []
    out = []
    for node in ast.walk(tree):
        if not (isinstance(node, ast.If) and node.orelse):
            continue
        test = node.test
        if not (isinstance(test, ast.Compare) and len(test.ops) == 1
                and isinstance(test.ops[0], (ast.Gt, ast.GtE))):
            continue
        left = test.left
        comp = test.comparators[0]
        if not (isinstance(left, ast.BinOp) and isinstance(left.op, ast.Mod)
                and isinstance(left.right, ast.Constant) and left.right.value == 36):
            continue
        if not isinstance(comp, ast.Constant):
            continue
        thresh = comp.value
        if not (isinstance(thresh, (int, float)) and 17 <= thresh <= 19):
            continue
        s, e = _span(source, node)
        indent = source[source.rfind('\n', 0, s) + 1:s]
        parts = []
        for st in node.orelse:
            ss, ee = _span(source, st)
            parts.append(source[ss:ee])
        new_text = ("\n" + indent).join(parts)
        out.append(_splice(source, node, new_text))
    return out

def _walk_sim_wrong_direction(source):

    and whose greedy step-direction logic doesn't match the correct
    parity/lower-bound stopping condition. Detected shape:

        X = int(input())
        ...
        while POS != X:
            COUNTER += 1
            <arbitrary branching updating POS by +/- COUNTER>

    Rewritten to the canonical stopping rule, keeping the student's own
    variable names so the rest of the file (e.g. the trailing print) still
    works unmodified.
    """
    try:
        tree = ast.parse(source)
    except SyntaxError:
        return []

    assign_node = _find_int_input_assign(tree)
    if assign_node is None:
        return []
    x_name = assign_node.targets[0].id

    already_abs = isinstance(assign_node.value, ast.Call) \
        and isinstance(assign_node.value.func, ast.Name) \
        and assign_node.value.func.id == 'abs'

    target_while = None
    pos_name = None
    for node in ast.walk(tree):
        if isinstance(node, ast.While):
            test = node.test
            if isinstance(test, ast.Compare) and len(test.ops) == 1 \
               and isinstance(test.ops[0], ast.NotEq):
                left, right = test.left, test.comparators[0]
                if isinstance(left, ast.Name) and isinstance(right, ast.Name):
                    names = [left.id, right.id]
                    if x_name in names and names[0] != names[1]:
                        pos_name = names[0] if names[1] == x_name else names[1]
                        target_while = node
                        break
    if target_while is None or not target_while.body:
        return []

    counter_name = None
    for sub in ast.walk(target_while):
        if isinstance(sub, ast.AugAssign) and isinstance(sub.op, ast.Add) \
           and isinstance(sub.target, ast.Name) \
           and isinstance(sub.value, ast.Constant) and sub.value.value == 1:
            counter_name = sub.target.id
            break
    if counter_name is None:
        return []

    indent = ' ' * target_while.body[0].col_offset

    edits = []

    body_s, _ = _span(source, target_while.body[0])
    _, body_e = _span(source, target_while.body[-1])
    new_body = f"{counter_name} += 1\n{indent}{pos_name} += {counter_name}"
    edits.append((body_s, body_e, new_body))

    test_s, test_e = _span(source, target_while.test)

        vs, ve = _span(source, assign_node.value)
        edits.append((vs, ve, f"abs({source[vs:ve]})"))

    return [_apply_edits(source, edits)]

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. An unconditional `return` sits *inside* the for-loop body (after an
#    `if ...: return i`), so it fires on the very first iteration.  Move it
#    out to after the loop.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _dedent_trailing_return(source):
    tree = _safe_parse(source)
    if tree is None:
        return []
    out = []
    lines = source.splitlines(keepends=True)
    for node in ast.walk(tree):
        if not isinstance(node, ast.For):
            continue
        if len(node.body) < 2 or not isinstance(node.body[-1], ast.Return):
            continue
        if not any(isinstance(s, ast.If) for s in node.body[:-1]):
            continue
        last = node.body[-1]
        if last.lineno != last.end_lineno:
            continue
        if last.lineno - 1 >= len(lines):
            continue
        for_line = lines[node.lineno - 1]
        for_indent = len(for_line) - len(for_line.lstrip())
        ret_idx = last.lineno - 1
        ret_line = lines[ret_idx]
        ret_indent = len(ret_line) - len(ret_line.lstrip())
        if ret_indent <= for_indent:
            continue
        new_lines = lines[:ret_idx] + lines[ret_idx + 1:]
        insert_idx = ret_idx
        new_stmt_line = (' ' * for_indent) + ret_line.strip() + '\n'
        new_lines = new_lines[:insert_idx] + [new_stmt_line] + new_lines[insert_idx:]
        candidate = ''.join(new_lines)
        if candidate != source:
            out.append(candidate)
    return out
